purpose: Record why the sealed redacted V0R evidence remains valid as semantic reference evidence but cannot serve as a legitimate full-viewport exact-RGBA baseline under the current 2-percent content-independent mask contract.

sealed_reference.receipt_observation_policy: Each capture interaction observation identifies the persisted artifact as redacted reference evidence.

machine_observed_baseline_conflict.method: The repository exact-pixel decoder read the sealed PNG as sRGB RGBA8, then every pixel in consecutive full-height columns from x=0 was compared with RGBA 36,36,36,255.
machine_observed_baseline_conflict.interpretation: The full-height privacy-redacted region is part of the sealed PNG bytes and is far larger than any admissible dynamic-region mask. It is not a candidate product surface that can be reproduced without evidence-tailored fake UI.

rejected_shortcuts: Do not render the sealed screenshot or its privacy blocks as candidate product UI.
Do not add a content-dependent or catch-all mask to hide layout differences.
Do not overwrite, silently edit, or falsely relabel the sealed V0R receipt.
Do not weaken zero-unmasked-RGBA or advance to O1B without an explicit contract decision.

required_direction.recommended: Authorize a superseding V0R-P1 corrective reference run under a new immutable receipt and screenshot root. Preserve the existing sealed receipt as semantic evidence, but collect pixel-baseline-compatible screenshots with deterministic synthetic content and no large content-dependent privacy occlusion.
required_direction.alternative: Explicitly amend the frozen V0B contract to use semantic, geometry, accessibility, and bounded reviewed dynamic masks instead of full-viewport exact RGBA against the current redacted reference. This is a weaker gate and is not assumed.
required_direction.authority_reason: The handoff explicitly says not to rerun completed evidence. Superseding the sealed V0R baseline or weakening its gate is therefore a material contract change that requires user direction.

next_action: Wait for explicit direction to supersede the immutable V0R pixel baseline or amend the frozen pixel contract; do not mutate external Notion or the candidate UI to simulate redaction before that direction.
